{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Check total number of converted customers
total_converted = len(converted_customers)
print(f"Total number of converted customers: {total_converted}")

# Check how many converted customers have missing age (age == -1)
missing_age_in_converted = (converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of converted customers with age == -1: {missing_age_in_converted}")

# Filter out rows with age == -1 for the mean calculation
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding age == -1): {mean_age}")

# Confirm count of valid converted customers
valid_count = len(valid_converted)
print(f"Number of valid converted customers (age != -1): {valid_count}")"}
